digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center Transport — outbound status transition
propositions: transition_issue_by_name matches requested names against transition names only, not destination status names, causing lookup failures when they differ
outbound status changes silently fail with soft_failed=True and a bridge_alerts entry instead of raising loudly, making partial sync look flaky

on classic workflows where transition names differ from status names (e.g. 'Start Progress' -> 'In Progress'), requests by destination status name find no matching transition and the issue status never changes
transition_issue_by_name must resolve requested names by destination status (to.name) as a fallback after exact transition-name match, and raise on ambiguous destinations rather than guessing
